title: A uniform dimension bound after all field extensions
statement: Let K be a field and let a:X→Spec K be locally of finite type and quasi-compact [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-scheme-over-base]. There exists a natural n such that for every field L, every s:Spec L→Spec K and every cartesian square with projections p₁:P→X and p₂:P→Spec L, the topological Krull dimension of P is at most n [def-kun-dimension, def-pc-fibre-product]. Empty schemes are allowed.

proof.text: Choose a finite affine open cover of X. On each chart Spec A, finite type supplies a surjection from a polynomial algebra in nᵢ variables over K onto A. After any field extension L this remains a surjection from L[t₁,…,t_nᵢ] onto A⊗_K L. Its quotient has dimension at most nᵢ. This is the source lemma exists_topologicalKrullDim_le_of_isPullback_of_isAffine; it constructs the chart comparison by pullbackSpecIso and applies ringKrullDim_tensorProduct_le_of_surjective.

Take the maximum of the finitely many nᵢ. Pullbacks of the chart opens cover P, and each has the corresponding chart bound. Apply the dimension bound for an open cover. For an empty cover X and its pullbacks are empty and dimension is bottom, so the finite supremum zero is still a bound.

lemma exists_topologicalKrullDim_le_of_isPullback {K : Type u} [Field K]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of K)) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ (L : Type u) [Field L] (s : Spec (.of L) ⟶ Spec (.of K)) {P : Scheme.{u}}
      (p₁ : P ⟶ X) (p₂ : P ⟶ Spec (.of L)), IsPullback p₁ p₂ f s →
      topologicalKrullDim P ≤ n
